interpretation.exploratory: Same previously inspected development cohort, exploratory/descriptive; no confirmatory significance, unseen-test, semantic-quality or recommendation claim.
interpretation.fit: Both LoRA development sourceCE worsened from2048 to4096, while final trainingCE was much lower; this is consistent with source-objective overfitting.4096 remains primary; no posthoc earliercheckpoint selection.
interpretation.next_decision: Retain strong lexical control. Do not automatically extend epochs or promote PPO/neural inference. Investigate source target/objective and label-support limits under a future fixed protocol; human semantic field labels remain empty.
interpretation.prefix: Seven of eight original endpoint0/512 state-and-prediction comparisons were exact. Only seed17 LoRA512 differed:50changed tensors, maxparameter difference0.0010762512683868408 and maxprobability difference0.020840346813201904; initialization/cohort/input/schedules matched. Cause remains unproven; CUDA nondeterminism is possible and the earlier256evaluation was omitted in the duration protocol. This is not an exact all-arm prefix replication claim.
interpretation.primary: LoRA two-seed mean final genre group/label recallat3 remained below matched lexical; final topic group/label means exceeded matched lexical. Seed29 LoRA genre group recallat3 was slightly below its paired frozen-encoder head, so LoRA did not dominate all outcomes.
